policies.title: Foreign CEMAC ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea visa-free short-visitor entry
policies.summary: Current CEMAC Commission material reports that visa-free movement of Member-State citizens is effective, while its published Convention supplies the tourist conditions. This maps the five foreign CEMAC ordinary-passport codes to the easier visa-free route in Equatorial Guinea.
conditions: Applies only to citizens holding ordinary passports of the five other current CEMAC Member States: Cameroon, the Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Chad and the Central African Republic.
For tourism, the published Convention describes a stay up to three months and requires a valid or recently expired national identity card or passport and an international health booklet.

Entry remains subject to applicable border, health, public-order, security and individual-admissibility controls. It does not establish work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee or special-document treatment.
No reviewed current Equatorial Guinea authority publishes an alternative nationality-wide electronic, airport-visa or bilateral route for this cohort.
